title: Italian-Style Kid-Friendly Tagine
description: A hearty and comforting Italian-inspired meal that's perfect for a family dinner. The tagine is a traditional North African cooking vessel, but we'll adapt the recipe to fit a more Italian flavor profile.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
3. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned.
4. Add the tomato sauce, cumin, and tagine spice blend. Stir to combine.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes.
6. Add the water and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot over rice or with crusty bread.
